# chDB

[https://github.com/chdb-io/chdb](https://github.com/chdb-io/chdb)

chDB is an embedded, in-process build of ClickHouse. This backend runs the
ClickHouse engine inside your Python process — no server required — and reuses
Ibis's ClickHouse SQL compiler and type system.

![](https://img.shields.io/badge/memtables-native-green?style=flat-square) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/inputs-local files | pandas | PyArrow-blue?style=flat-square) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/outputs-CSV | pandas | Parquet | PyArrow-orange?style=flat-square)

## Install

Install Ibis and the chDB engine:

```{.bash}
pip install 'ibis-framework[chdb]' chdb
```

::: {.callout-note}
`chdb` is installed on its own rather than pulled in by the `chdb` extra: it
requires `pyarrow>=13`, which is incompatible with the pins of some other
backends, so bundling it would make the extras unresolvable together.
:::

And connect:

```{.python}
import ibis

con = ibis.chdb.connect()  # <1>
```

1. Defaults to an in-memory database; pass a directory for a persistent one.

## Connect

### `ibis.chdb.connect`

```python
con = ibis.chdb.connect()  # in-memory
con = ibis.chdb.connect("/path/to/db")  # persistent, on disk
```

::: {.callout-note}
`ibis.chdb.connect` is a thin wrapper around [`ibis.backends.chdb.Backend.do_connect`](#ibis.backends.chdb.Backend.do_connect).
:::

::: {.callout-note}
chDB runs one engine per process: the first connection fixes the on-disk path,
and connecting to a different path raises until the open connections are closed.
:::

### Connection Parameters

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from _utils import render_do_connect

render_do_connect("chdb")
```

### `ibis.connect` URL format

In addition to `ibis.chdb.connect`, you can connect by passing a path-based URL
to `ibis.connect`:

```python
con = ibis.connect("chdb:///path/to/db")  # persistent
con = ibis.connect("chdb://")  # in-memory
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
BACKEND = "chDB"
```
